definitions.explanation: Something that combines two different elements, technologies, or approaches. Most commonly used in Japan for hybrid vehicles (combining gasoline and electric motors), but also applied broadly to mixed systems, styles, or formats.

examples.japanese: ハイブリッド{車|しゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}えた→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I switched to a hybrid car.

examples.japanese: ハイブリッド{型|がた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{対面|たいめん}→対面：10377_taimen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせる→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧。
examples.english: In hybrid-style classes, in-person and online formats are combined.

examples.japanese: {和|わ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{洋|よう}→洋：28890_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ハイブリッドな⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Hybrid cuisine blending Japanese and Western styles is gaining popularity among young people.

notes:
USAGE: ハイブリッド is a loanword from English "hybrid." In Japan, it is most strongly associated with hybrid vehicles, but its use has expanded to describe any combination of two different approaches.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ハイブリッド{車|しゃ} / ハイブリッドカー (hybrid car)
- ハイブリッド{型|がた} (hybrid-type, hybrid-format)
- ハイブリッド⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧ (hybrid work — mixing office and remote work)
- プラグインハイブリッド (plug-in hybrid)

ABBREVIATION: Often shortened to ハイブリ in casual speech.
